p='/app/output/gen.py'
s=open(p).read();s=s.replace("include_depth=True,video='none',note=label)","cameras=[CAM,EYE],include_depth=True,video='none',note=label)")
pos=s.index("if __name__=='__main__':")
s=s[:pos]+'''def cart(r,target,rot=None,step=.035,label='cart',grip=None):
    p0=prop(load_meta())[26:29];C0=np.array(load_meta()['cameras'][EYE]['cam2world_gl'])[:3,:3]
    if rot is None:rot=C0
    rv=Rotation.from_matrix(C0.T@rot).as_rotvec()
    N=max(1,int(np.ceil(max(np.linalg.norm(np.asarray(target)-p0)/step,np.linalg.norm(rv)/.15))))
    for i in range(1,N+1):
        p=p0+(np.asarray(target)-p0)*i/N;C=C0@Rotation.from_rotvec(rv*i/N).as_matrix()
        move(r,p,C,.7,label+str(i),grip)
        err=np.linalg.norm(prop(load_meta())[26:29]-p)
        if err>.035:
            print('STOP tracking error',err,flush=True);return False
    return True

'''+s[pos:];open(p,'w').write(s)
